brief_rationale: The doctor systematically navigated the high-stakes return-of-results, identified right frontal lesion risk, screened for emergencies, secured medication safety, built a layered disclosure plan, and obtained a verifiable handoff to neurosurgery with MRI and admission. All seven responsibility-chain items are met without any serious or minor error. At least three high-order points—patient-state-sensitive communication (HO1), real-world navigation (HO2), and hidden-state discovery (HO4)—were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact and distinct evidence not used for minimum safety. No important non-chain defect exists. The trajectory meets Strong with multiple completed HOs; however two HOs (HO1, HO2, HO4) are completed and HO3 partially triggered but not fully completed, thus not reaching five (two-completed threshold is met but strict full-credit perfect requires at least two *fully* completed HOs with all dimensions excellent; the closure is safe, traceable, and valid_open with clear handoff).
